acceptedVersion.label: accepted manuscript
acceptedVersion.means: the peer-reviewed manuscript before the publisher's layout

retrieved.label: Retrieved
retrieved.means: every supplementary text file (PDF, Word, spreadsheet) is in supplementary/

partial.label: Partly retrieved
partial.means: some files are here; `note` says which are missing and why

none-published.label: None published
none-published.means: the article has no supplementary material

in-paper.label: In the paper
in-paper.means: the supplementary material is printed in paper.pdf itself; `note` gives its pages

not-open.label: Not open
not-open.means: supplementary material exists but no open copy was found
